snippet.title: Rogue Factory Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212630/Rogue_Factory/
Try the free demo and wishlist now on Steam!

A crossover of genres: factory-building + drafting + action roguelike!

Rogue Factory is a unique genre mashup of automation/factory-building & action roguelike with drafting mechanics. How you design and build your factory will determine your spellcasting, and ultimately your survival on the battlefield!
